reading.body:
The operator of this facility is not published and could not be identified from available sources. The facility name alone, "Secure Data Center," provides no distinguishing information. Without a website, detailed address, or operator attribution in the registry, no specifications for power capacity, cooling, or IT load can be confirmed.

Georgia has 33 mapped data center facilities, of which only 4 publish power capacity figures totaling 66.3 megawatts. This facility ranks fifth by published megawatts in the state, which means it either publishes no figure or the publication is not in this registry's sources. The state's actual capacity is certainly much larger than the 66.3 megawatts on record, since most mapped facilities do not disclose their power draw.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be assessed for its role in AI scaling. To matter to AI compute, a facility must be both real and characterized. This record remains an open research item.
